test_title: English Language and Comprehension Mock Test 66

questions.question: Select the most appropriate proverb that can substitute the underlined part in the given sentence. Swati was settled in her profession of law, but feeling unhappy and imitating Ajay, she quit and opted for accounts. She always feels that others are in better situations than her.​
options: the grass is greener on the other side
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (the grass is greener on the other side) है।

questions.question: Select the most appropriate idiom to fill in the blank.Despite the initial skepticism, the new product quickly gained popularity, and sales soared. The company's decision to invest in innovative technology proved to be a ________.
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.A strong desire to travel
Select the most appropriate verb to fill in the blank.Every morning, he _________ a glass of milk before leaving for work.
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.Absence of rain for a long time

Select the most appropriate article to fill in the blank. If no article is required, select 'No article required'.Despite the heavy rain, _______ concert went ahead as planned, much to the delight of the audience.
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.__________ I could hardly raise my arms above my aching side, I kept working.
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.They refused to speak _____ fear that the stranger might hear their doubts and turn hostile.

Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the right order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.A. His early years were marked by poverty and struggle, which shaped his worldview.B. Through sheer determination, he rose from his humble beginnings to become a respected leader.C. Despite facing numerous challenges, he never lost his vision for a better future.D. Today, he is celebrated not only for his leadership but also for his unwavering commitment to social justice.

Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.A. After months of uncertainty, the decision brought a sense of relief.B. The entire team had been waiting anxiously for the final verdict from the management.C. The manager walked into the room with an air of authority, carrying the document that held the key to their future.D. As soon as he announced the decision, the tension in the room dissipated instantly.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (B - C - D - A) है।

questions.question: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM for the given word. Liable

Comprehension:Read the given passage and answer the questions that follow.Clara was carried up the mountain by two strong servants, her face pale but full of quiet determination. Heidi ran to meet her, beaming. "You are here!" she cried. Grandfather watched from the doorway, his expression unreadable.Once inside, Clara looked around curiously. The hut was small but clean, with wooden beams and a large stove The scent of herbs hung in the air. "It's lovely, "she whispered. Heidi clapped her hands. "Wait till you see the view!"Grandfather bought fresh milk and bread. Clara sipped hesitatingly, then smiled, "It tastes different here", she said. "Better.""That is fine mountain air", said the grandfather. He had now finished his meal and was standing near Clara studying her with a keen gaze. Then he went out to the shed and brought out two thick wooden boards, which he began adjusting with hammer and nails.Heidi watched curiously. "What are you making, Grandfather?", she asked. "Something to help Clara sit more comfortably outside", he replied, "Your chair from Frankfurt won't do well on these slopes.” Clara’s eyes shone with gratitude. “Oh, thank you!”, she said softly. “I was just thinking how much I would love to see properly.What is the meaning of the word 'beaming' as used in the passage?
